notes: Smith County, Texas (Tyler), not Deaf Smith County. Network opened about 14:07 UTC; county pages, the SOS list and Tyler Morning Telegraph articles were then fetched directly with the fetch module. The results page (fetch_module, hash 2df161f0...) states verbatim: 'Early Voting and Absentee results will be posted here on Election Night at 7 pm. After all locations deliver their Election Day ballots, those results will be tabulated, and the resulting report(s) will replace the previous document posted. The final results will be posted after Canvassing (this usually takes about 2 weeks after an election). If you have any questions, please contact our office at 903-590-4777.' Election-night documents are replaced, and the page now lists only post-canvass documents for 2026 (e.g. '2026-03 Official Precinct Report (PDF)', '2026-05 Official Precinct Report (PDF)' for the May 26 runoff, plus canvass, summary and polling place reports). This shows precinct reports exist after canvass but does not say whether the election-night report(s) included precinct detail, so no timing tag is supported. Result PDFs are hosted in a Laserfiche portal (portal.laserfiche.com/Portal/DocView.aspx?...&repo=r-927d42fb) linked from the county page; platform recorded as county_pdfs (county-posted static PDF reports) with that caveat; the Laserfiche archive browse page returned HTTP 302 to the fetch module. News timing of final unofficial reports (none mention precinct-level detail): Nov 5 2024 tylerpaper 'As of 10 p.m., 38 of 38 polling places reported results'; Mar 3 2026 tylerpaper 'The following results are as reported in Smith County’s final report Tuesday night, which was published just before 10:30 p.m.'; May 26 2026 tylerpaper 'The following results reported by Smith County at 9:40 p.m. Tuesday include all early voting totals, absentee ballots and Election Day ballots. These results are complete for the night but considered unofficial until they are canvassed.' Contact: phone from the county results page (quoted above) and SOS Election Duties list (SMITH COUNTY, Elections Administrator Michelle Allcon, 302 E Ferguson St, Tyler 75702, County Email Address mailto:scelections@smith-county.com, (903) 590-4777). Usage notice: the results page has no distribution or usage notice; only the generic site footer link 'Copyright Notices', so usage_notice_text is empty. Stated change: no 2025/2026 statement about precinct-level results reporting found. Wayback: wayback_probe (3 CDX windows) failed robots_disallowed_or_unreachable; archive.org/wayback/available queried at 12 points for www.smith-county.com/236/Current-Election-Results found no snapshot inside any window; nearest candidate is 20260304090704 (Mar 4 2026 03:07 CST), just after the primary window, which cannot be opened here.
